scope: execution-driven two-core single-writer HUSH subset, independently written cycle-level model; not gem5
cache_model: four dedicated receiver slots, no replacement; writer retains authoritative data
arbitration: nonpreemptive two-client round robin, one outstanding request per core; miss grant waits for at most one 1-cycle private store, then reserves shared responsibility
selection: dynamic finite-domain enumeration; fixed baseline exhaustively scans all 255 legal loads. Admit with phase-independent relative-age bound, select two-task makespan at phi=0.
report: real cycles in this architecture model, reader bound/observed time, writer completion, makespan, misses, update packets/deliveries, safe-hit errors; retain regressions and empty feasible sets
bootstrap_case: BSQ: four cold reads, 32 steady reads, then one read and private compute; same four blocks and CPU gap4
